method.nao_ao: CPC daily standardized observed indices; monthly values are arithmetic means of the observed daily index (>=90% coverage).
method.enso: CPC ERSSTv6 3-month overlapping seasons; ONI absolute SST anomaly, RONI relative anomaly; official ENSO monitoring uses RONI from 2026.
method.episodes: Warm/cold ±0.5 degC for at least five consecutive overlapping 3-month seasons; short threshold crossings are not confirmed episodes.

gbi.label: Grönland-Blocking (GBI)
gbi.method: Eigene Standardisierung des NOAA/PSL 500-hPa-Höhengebietsmittels: monatliche Anomalie / Monats-Standardabweichung 1981–2010

soi.label: Southern Oscillation Index (SOI)
soi.method: CPC Tahiti minus Darwin, standardisierte Monatswerte

mei.label: Multivariate ENSO Index v2 (MEI.v2)
mei.method: NOAA PSL JRA3Q; überlappende 2-Monatswerte, DJ..ND; Monatslabel = zweiter Monat

u30.label: QBO-U30, 30 hPa
u30.method: CPC zonaler Wind in 30 hPa, positive Werte = Westwind

u50.label: QBO-U50, 50 hPa
u50.method: CPC zonaler Wind in 50 hPa, positive Werte = Westwind

mjo.label: Wheeler–Hendon RMM (BOM)
mjo.method: Original RMM1/RMM2 und Phasen aus BOM, 1974–heute; Amplitude <1 schwach
